title: Arcane Relics & Potions — Animation Upgrade Revision 2

items.name: Mana Potion
items.break_description: A wide violet-and-cyan liquid splash with separated angular glass shards from the original potion. The broken bottle itself is derived from the approved base sprite.

items.name: Healing Elixir
items.break_description: A wide warm-gold liquid splash with separated angular glass shards from the original elixir. The broken bottle itself is derived from the approved base sprite.

items.name: Arcane Crystal
items.orbit_description: A thin broken ring of tiny violet and cyan magical particles orbiting a central crystal-shaped empty space, with generous transparency between particles.

items.name: Spell Tome
items.open_description: Retained for recipe compatibility; revision 2 preserves the approved tome and animates its existing rune energy instead of asking the model to redraw a different book.

items.name: Alchemist Flask
items.reaction_description: Retained for recipe compatibility; revision 2 animates the detected liquid region deterministically and does not generate confetti.

items.name: Ritual Candle
items.smoke_description: A small delicate curl of pale violet-gray pixel smoke rising from an empty candle wick, sparse and narrow with generous transparent space.

items.name: Enchanted Wand
items.release_description: A compact cyan-and-violet magical spell burst with a bright core, short rays, and a few tiny particles. It must be a standalone transparent VFX asset with no wand baked into it.
